intention: /supercharger-stats renders from charge_sessions through a charging read port, instead of telemetry's raw supercharger_sessions buffer.
request:
Source ticket: MAG-30 — https://linear.app/magus-monitor/issue/MAG-30/supercharger-stats-reads

I think the page /supercharger-stats is reading data from the telemetry module instead of analytics.

The supercharger_sessions database table, is only used for reading purposes by the analytics module. Then the analytics module does some calculations and save the read data into the charge_sessions database table. (Belong to the `charging` module)

The page /supercharger-stats should read data from the `charge_sessions` instead of the raw data from tesla's fleet api. Can you please double check and apply that change?

You can gather more context on this KB document /kkpa/context/workflows/supercharger-stats-read

Acceptance Criteria

1. /supercharger-stats reads data from charge_sessions database table via `charging` module. The gateway module should point to that out.
2. Telemetry module is not used by the `gateway` module. Any endpoint should point out to different database tables rather than the own by the `telemetry` module. What are your thoughts, am I right that `gateway` should not read any data from `telemetry` module? If there are existing uses from gateway to telemetry different from the supercharger session, please create a ticket for that
3. Update the KB

decisions.decision: drop CountryCode + BillingType from the page rather than adding the columns to charge_sessions
decisions.why: User chose minimal scope over a migration + backfill. Removes all DB work, so the database design gate does not trip.

decisions.decision: gateway keeps telemetry.Reader/Snapshot; file a follow-up ticket instead of removing it
decisions.why: telemetry owns live snapshots and has no other owner; only the supercharger path is misfiled. User asked for a follow-up ticket anyway.

decisions.decision: window the new read port on charge_stop_date_time, not charge_start_date_time
decisions.why: idx_charge_sessions_vehicle_stop leads on stop time, so no sort and no new index; roadmap D12 already ruled stop-time correct. Shifts month-straddling sessions.

decisions.decision: ran the Step 2 interview before creating the roadmap, inverting Step 1b/Step 2 order
decisions.why: Tier structure depended on the column-parity answer; creating tiers first would have meant rewriting them in the same commit.

tiers.notes: Artifacts only this run; implementation halted for user review per pickup-ticket scope.
